title.narrative: Project to ensure the long-term sustainability of vulnerable productive landscapes and ecosystems in Mali’s Koulikoro Region amid climate changes and reverse deforestation and land degradation while building community resilience and contributing to conflict prevention

description.narrative: The joint project will directly benefit 8,642 persons (4,660 women and 3,982 men) who will be directly involved in or benefit from project activities under outcome 2 and 3 that will strengthen their household’s and community’s resilience capacities.

The project aims to ensure the long-term sustainability of vulnerable productive landscapes and ecosystems in Mali’s Koulikoro Region amid climate changes and reverse deforestation and land degradation while building community resilience and contributing to conflict prevention. It will be doing so by i) reinforcing public partnerships and leverage investments in climate change adaption and sustainable management of natural resources, ii) supporting peaceful, sustainable, and inclusive governance of land, forests, and water, and ii) strengthening community and household-level resilience, notably for women and youth, amid climate change. The project builds on and scales up UNDP’s existing climate, peace and security portfolio, UNCDF’s Local Climate Adaptive Living Facility and complements Enabel’s PTCS 2022-2026. In Mali heeft een combinatie van natuurlijke en antropogene druk geresulteerd in een intens proces van landdegradatie, ontbossing en woestijnvorming, met verlies aan biodiversiteit en bodemvruchtbaarheid, wat gevolgen heeft voor de productiviteit en het levensonderhoud van de bevolking. De impact van de klimaatverandering is al zeer reëel en heeft zich de afgelopen tien jaar verder gemanifesteerd. Het project heeft tot doel de duurzaamheid op lange termijn van fragiele landschappen en ecosystemen in de Malinese Koulikoro-regio te garanderen. Ook zal het project ontbossing en landdegradatie tegengaan met het oog op het verhogen van de veerkracht van de gemeenschap het bijdragen aan conflictpreventie. Concrete doelstellingen i), investeren in klimaatadaptatie en het duurzame beheren van natuurlijke hulpbronnen stimuleren, ii) het ondersteunen van vreedzaam, duurzaam en inclusief bestuur van land, bossen en water, en iii) de veerkracht van gemeenschappen versterken in het licht van de klimaatverandering. Het project bouwt voort op de bestaande klimaat-, vredes- en veiligheidsportfolio van UNDP en de Local Climate Adaptive Living (LoCAL) Facility van UNCDF.

The project overall objective is to ensure the long-term sustainability of vulnerable productive landscapes in Mali’s Koulikoro Region through public and community investments in nature-based solutions that simultaneously reverse deforestation, land degradation, strengthen households’, communities’ and local economies’ resilience to climate change impacts and contribute to conflict prevention. - Reinforce public partnerships and leverage investments in climate change adaption. - Strengthen capacities of local authorities, technical services and communities to address climate-related risks and sustainable management of natural resources in local planning and investments. - Support peaceful, sustainable, and inclusive governance of land, forests, and water. - Strengthen community and household-level resilience, notably for women and youth, amid climate change. Result 1: Strengthened climate change adaptation policy framework and partnerships Result 2: Preservation and peaceful and sustainable management of ecosystems and natural resources Result 3: Improved resilience of farming communities facing climate change and environmental degradation
